openQuestions: Every Maruti line is duplicated in model-lines-auto and model-line-additions; the modelFixes above are written against model-lines-auto and should be applied to the matching additions row too.

Most Maruti lines are India-only. For a Czech buyer the relevant Maruti-built cars are the European Suzuki Alto (2002–2014, F10D), Baleno hatchback (2016–2019, from Manesar) and e Vitara (from 2025, from Hansalpur). Should those cards cross-link the suzuki make cards?
Dzire II from: the Dzire article gives 2011 but the second-gen Dzire went on sale in 2012, so it was left null.
Baleno and Brezza facelifts dated 2026 come from one Wikipedia table only; details are not verified.
summary: Every Maruti Suzuki card had unknown years and status. All 30 lines now have sourced production years, status as of 2026-10 and Indian generation codes where published (Swift RS/AZG/A2L/AOL, Ertiga ZE/NC, Baleno WB). Ciaz (ended 2025) and the e Vitara (built for Europe since 2025) are corrected, and 47 run-together text strings are repaired.
